subject: Any possibility to use or develop INLA for flexible parametric relative survival model?

messages.author: 8e04d3c51038d0ad
messages.subject: Any possibility to use or develop INLA for flexible parametric relative survival model?
parts:
Hi Rue and all the INLA team members,

Our team at Ontario Health are using a flexible parametric relative survival model which can be found in rstpm2 package in the non-spatial format. Now we have to use OpenBUGs which is really slow for the large dataset we have. I also talked to Rue about it in the talk he had virtually in Toronto. Not sure How we can get connected to see if we can work together and make INLA works for our model and resolve the computational time issue we have now with OpenBUGs.

Regards,

Shabnam Balamchi , PhD
Decision Scientist, Data and Decision Sciences
